text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: each arm's quantile score (dot) with its 95% interval from re-drawing whole weeks of forecast start and seeds. Bottom: the three planned contrasts with 98.33% intervals. Line at 0: same score. Dashed line: a gain of 0.5% of am's score, the smallest gain worth a table of shares. Five Primary substations, daylight half-hours of April to September, forecast runs one every 5 days: July to September 2025 and April to June 2026. Quantile score in points of capacity (1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity).'
text.tspan: Top: each arm's quantile score (dot) with its 95% interval from re-drawing whole
weeks of forecast start and seeds. Bottom: the three planned contrasts with
98.33% intervals. Line at 0: same score. Dashed line: a gain of 0.5% of am's
score, the smallest gain worth a table of shares. Five Primary substations,
daylight half-hours of April to September, forecast runs one every 5 days: July
to September 2025 and April to June 2026. Quantile score in points of capacity
(1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity).
